issues.description: Constructor parameter list mismatch for class Bitmap24: the template header (template_repository/example_program/src/Bitmap24.hpp) declares a three-parameter constructor Bitmap24(int i_width, int i_height, int depth) (line 38), while the template implementation (template_repository/example_program/src/Bitmap24.cpp) defines a two-parameter constructor Bitmap24::Bitmap24(int p_width, int p_height) (line 26). The solution repository also uses the two-parameter constructor (solution_repository/example_program/src/Bitmap24.hpp line 38 and solution_repository/example_program/src/Bitmap24.cpp line 26). This inconsistency between the header and the implementation can confuse students and may cause compilation or linkage issues when declarations and definitions do not match.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the constructor signature consistent across header and implementation. Recommended: change the template header declaration to Bitmap24(int i_width, int i_height) to match the implementation and the solution. If a three-parameter constructor is intentionally required, implement and document a matching three-parameter constructor in Bitmap24.cpp and update the solution and any call sites accordingly. Prefer the first option (two-parameter header) to align template and solution.
